<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Index Rejig:</strong> BSE is set to replace Wipro in the Nifty 50 index effective September 30, 2026, a move expected to trigger portfolio rebalancing for passive funds.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty faced significant selling pressure, falling over 400 points and slipping below 24,500, as investors reacted to rising crude oil prices and broader market volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude Oil Impact:</strong> Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have pushed crude oil prices higher, negatively impacting domestic market sentiment and putting pressure on the Indian Rupee, which traded lower at 95.38 against the US dollar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQMUd5YjdBTVJiQ2NNc3M2S1duZ0JVLWRPWUdqbXIySzlfdHJGdl9QTXBuMk81OEExclZ6QW9SNGZ2RXNIU0d4TUI5RThtUk5zMTNFRjctOTdpSklIUnQ4WWFSUk55NUhEUExGQjBZMnlQT3ZRTjVVZ3d4ZVotRW9jWVpGalB1dEI2SjVsZXBpZmxZVnlsbi1NSWZCYXdpcTRtRXJScjRzVWp4b2tGQlE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
